summary: Frontend-only retest using Playwright at 1920x1080 and 390x844. PASSED: (1) With nj_progress_v1='[]', a direct load of /level/2.1 now redirects to /journey with no blank page. /level/9.9 also redirects. (2) Pitch waveform no longer jitters: the hire-to-unlock-button Y position stayed at 800px across 8 samples, and a normal click (no force) shows the 'Challenge accepted.' toast. (4) Interests card shows 4 interest-chip elements: [Interest 1]..[Interest 4]. (5) contact-linkedin-link points to https://www.linkedin.com/in/nandish-s-2291541a4 and contact-github-link points to https://github.com/nandish3010. Both have target=_blank and rel=noopener noreferrer. (6) No 'Wispr Flow' on /, /journey, /pitch, /design-prompt or /wishlist. 'Supertails' is spelled correctly and no misspellings were found. (7) Regression: level 1.1 choice -> reveal-panel appears -> choices disabled -> continue goes to /level/1.2 and saves ['1.1']. Wishlist totals update correctly ($850 -> $1150 -> $2250, then removing the mic gives $1950 with 2 items). Design prompt copy works (4667 chars plus toast) and download gives nandish-the-journey-design-prompt.md. Mobile menu opens, closes on nav, Esc and overlay click, with no horizontal overflow. FAILED: (3) The mobile menu a11y fix was NOT applied. Header.jsx still has no SheetTitle or SheetDescription, and the Radix DialogTitle error and Description warning still appear in the console. Minor: the locked-level toast does not show on a direct load, and it shows twice on client-side navigation.

ui_bugs.issue: Fix not applied. SheetContent has no SheetTitle or SheetDescription. Console shows '`DialogContent` requires a `DialogTitle`' (error) and 'Missing `Description` or aria-describedby' (warning) each time the menu opens.
Direct load of a locked level redirects but shows no 'That level is still locked.' toast. On client-side navigation to a locked level, the toast appears twice.

action_items: Header.jsx: import SheetTitle and SheetDescription from '@/components/ui/sheet' and add them inside SheetContent (for example <SheetTitle className='sr-only'>Navigation</SheetTitle><SheetDescription className='sr-only'>Site navigation menu</SheetDescription>).

LevelPlay.jsx / App.js (low priority): to make the locked toast reliable, either move <Toaster/> above <Routes> in App.js so it subscribes before child effects run, or pass the message through navigate state (<Navigate to='/journey' replace state={{locked:true}}/>) and show the toast from Journey. For the duplicate, use a stable toast id: toast('That level is still locked.', { id: 'level-locked' }).
critical_code_review_comments: LevelPlay: the reset effect on [id] sets toastedRef=false. Under StrictMode the effects run mount -> unmount -> mount, so the ref guard resets and the toast fires twice. Using a toast id is the simplest fix.
Sonner's Toaster is rendered after Routes, so it subscribes after LevelPlay's effect calls toast() on first mount, and the toast is lost.
Wishlist count label reads '1 items' (should be singular '1 item'). Cosmetic.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (6/7 requested checks passed; mobile a11y fix missing)

seed_data_creation: None. Only localStorage in the test browser was changed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To unlock S3, seed nj_progress_v1 with ['1.1','1.2','1.3','2.1','2.2','2.3','2.4','2.5','2.6']. The waveform is now stable, so force clicks are not needed. Remaining work: the mobile Sheet a11y warning (check the console after clicking mobile-menu-button) and the minor locked-toast behavior.
rca of the issue: Mobile a11y: Header.jsx (lines 78-107) still renders SheetContent with no SheetTitle or SheetDescription, so the fix from iteration 1 was never made. Missing toast: App.js renders <Toaster/> after <Routes>. On first mount, LevelPlay's useEffect runs before the Toaster's subscribe effect, so the toast event is dropped. Double toast: StrictMode re-runs effects, and the [id] effect resets toastedRef before the toast effect runs again.
